application_credentials.description:
This integration signs in to YNAB with **your own** OAuth application, so your access token never passes through anyone else's app.

1. Open [YNAB Developer Settings]({developer_settings_url}) and create a **New Application**.
2. Give it a name that does not start with "YNAB" (YNAB's rule), for example "Bank Feed Alert for YNAB (home)".
3. Set the **Redirect URI** to `{redirect_url}`.
4. Leave **Default plan selection** off.
5. Save, then copy the **Client ID** and **Client Secret** here.

The integration asks YNAB for read-only access; it can never change your plan.

plan.title: Choose a plan
plan.description: Your YNAB account has more than one plan. Pick the one whose bank connections to watch; add the integration again for another.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to YNAB again
reauth_confirm.description: YNAB no longer accepts this integration's authorisation. Sign in again to keep watching your bank connections.

abort.already_configured: This plan is already being watched.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach YNAB. Try again in a moment.
abort.no_plans: This YNAB account has no plans to watch.
abort.wrong_account: That YNAB account cannot see the plan this entry watches. Sign in with the account that owns it.
abort.missing_configuration: The integration is not configured. Add your YNAB OAuth application under Application Credentials first.
abort.missing_credentials: Add your YNAB OAuth application under Application Credentials first.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Timed out generating the authorisation URL.
abort.no_url_available: No URL available. See the documentation for the redirect URI.
abort.oauth_failed: Could not get an access token from YNAB.
abort.oauth_timeout: Timed out getting an access token from YNAB.
abort.oauth_unauthorized: YNAB refused the authorisation. Check the Client ID, Client Secret and Redirect URI.
abort.oauth_implementation_unavailable: The OAuth implementation is unavailable. Try again later.

init.title: Escalation
init.description: How long a bank connection may stay broken before the alert escalates: the repair becomes an error and the *Reconnect overdue* sensor turns on.

reconnect_needed.title: YNAB bank connections need reconnecting ({plan})
reconnect_needed.description:
{count} linked account(s) in **{plan}** have stopped importing because their bank connection needs attention: {accounts}.

Broken since at least {since}. Open YNAB, go to **Manage Bank Connections**, and reconnect each one. This alert clears itself at the next check after they are healthy again.

If they are still broken after {days} day(s), this becomes an error.

reconnect_overdue.title: YNAB bank connections still need reconnecting ({plan})
reconnect_overdue.description:
{count} linked account(s) in **{plan}** have been unable to import since at least {since}: {accounts}.

Transactions are piling up outside YNAB. Open YNAB, go to **Manage Bank Connections**, and reconnect each one now. This alert clears itself at the next check after they are healthy again.
